name: Jefferson Apartments
address: 614 Washington St. S.E. Apt. #8, Blacksburg, Virginia 24060
text:
Common Fee list 2025

- "Application (& co-signer): $35"
- "Change of Roommate: $50"
- "Sublease $100"
- "Security Deposit $400-$800 or 1 Month's rent"
- "Pet Deposit $400-$500"
- "Pet Rent $15-20/month"
- "Caged Animals $30-$50"
- "Cleaning Fee $100-$300"
- "Additional may be charged for specific items"

Uncommon Fees

- "Incomplete/invalid or no Notice to Vacate submitted: $35"
- "Fines- $25 or more"
- "Re-rental Fee: $175.00"
- "Less than 90 days required notice before lease expiration: Starting at $30"
- "Unapproved Roommate or animal Fee starting at $150.00"

[From the home page https://www.jeffersonapt.com, verbatim:]
- "Plentiful off-street parking; no resident parking fee."
- "Water, sewer and trash pick-up are included for most units."
- "24 hour maintenance service included."
- "Coin or app operated laundry facilities in each building."
notes: Good fee schedule (titled 'Common Fee list 2025' at URL /2021-fees) but no rent prices on the fees or home page.
